spree-backend.description: Spree Commerce backend agent — Rails, API, decorators, migrations, Sidekiq, RSpec. Works exclusively in backend/. Auto-saves progress to SESSION.md.

spree-storefront.description: Next.js storefront agent — React 19, App Router, Spree SDK, Tailwind, Biome, Vitest. Works exclusively in apps/storefront/. Auto-saves progress to SESSION.md.

code-review.description: Read-only code reviewer — security, performance, Spree conventions, React patterns. Does not modify files. Saves findings to SESSION.md.

chapter-plan.description: Create a chapter-by-chapter plan for a new feature
chapter-plan.template: Guide the user through creating a chapter-by-chapter development plan for a new feature. Propose chapters with goals, DB changes, API endpoints, and test plans. Save to SESSION.md after user approval.

resume.description: Resume from the last saved session
resume.template: Read .opencode/SESSION.md. Present the active chapter, last completed work, pending tasks, and known blockers. Ask the user where to continue. Auto-delegate to the correct agent.

seed.description: Seed the database with sample data
seed.template: Run `spree seed` to populate the database with seed data. If sample products/categories/images are needed, also run `spree sample-data`. After seeding, verify the admin panel shows products at http://localhost:3000/admin.

test:backend.template: Run the Rails test suite from the backend directory. Use `bundle exec rspec` for the full suite, or target specific files. Show any failures with their error messages and suggest fixes. After tests pass, note any deprecation warnings.

test:frontend.description: Run storefront lint, format check, and tests
test:frontend.template: From apps/storefront, run `npm run check` for Biome lint and format check, then `npm run test` for Vitest. Fix any issues. Use `npm run format` to auto-fix formatting. Show test results and any lint violations.

save-progress.description: Save current session progress to SESSION.md
save-progress.template: Review the current session. Write a concise summary to `.opencode/SESSION.md` covering: 1) Active chapter/feature being worked on, 2) What was implemented this session, 3) What remains to be done next, 4) Key decisions made, 5) Any blockers encountered. Do NOT overwrite previous entries — prepend new entries under a ## Session date header. Ask the user to confirm the summary is accurate before saving.

dev.template: Start the backend with `npm run dev` (from project root). In a separate terminal, start the storefront with `cd apps/storefront && npm run dev`. Wait for both to be healthy. Backend at http://localhost:3000, Storefront at http://localhost:3001.

deploy-check.template: Run the complete pre-deployment checklist: 1) Backend: `bundle exec rspec`, `bundle exec brakeman`, `bundle exec bundle-audit check --update`. 2) Storefront: `npm run check`, `npm run test`. 3) Git: check for uncommitted changes, ensure version tag if releasing. Report pass/fail for each step.
